definitions.explanation: A political and economic union of European countries promoting integration and cooperation.

examples.japanese: EU⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加盟|かめい}→加盟：05769_kamei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
EU⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The EU has strict environmental regulations.

examples.japanese: ⟦イギリス→イギリス：28283_igirisu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2020⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧EU⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離脱|りだつ}→離脱：14583_ridatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
EU (European Union / ⟦{欧州|おうしゅう}→欧州：13186_oushuu⟧⟦{連合|れんごう}→連合：14450_rengou⟧) is a major international organization frequently mentioned in Japanese news.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- EU⟦{加盟|かめい}{国|こく}→加盟国：19160_kameikoku⟧: EU member state
- EU⟦{離脱|りだつ}→離脱：14583_ridatsu⟧: EU withdrawal (Brexit)
- EU⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: EU regulations
- EU⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧: European Parliament
- EU⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: EU summit

EU is written in the English alphabet in Japanese text. The Japanese term ⟦{欧州|おうしゅう}→欧州：13186_oushuu⟧⟦{連合|れんごう}→連合：14450_rengou⟧ is used in formal contexts.
